author: Praxis IV
title: Baseline generalization: noFW (kd=20, δ=0.15, λ=0.70), k=52 vs k=50
abstract: Tests whether increasing neighborhood size to k=52 is also detrimental on a simpler baseline (no GraphFWPCA weighting) at kd=20, δ=0.15, λ=0.70. Compare to k=50 result (EID 1090=0.7329).
